description: Get an ENS name's ownership and registration state, e.g. 'Who owns ens.eth and when does it expire?'. Returns a one-line summary, status (available, registered, grace, expired, reserved), ENS version, owner, manager and registrant, resolver, expiry and grace period, and whether it is wrapped, can be registered or renewed. Ask for burned NameWrapper fuses or ENSv2 migration readiness with include. To check what one account may do, use get_permissions.

include.description: Extra details: fuses (wrapped names), migration (moving an ENSv1 name to ENSv2)

name.description: ENS name as the user wrote it, e.g. nick.eth; normalised by the server (ENSIP-15)

name: get_name_details

expiry.description: End of the registration, grace period excluded; absent when it never expires

at.description: ISO 8601 date and time in UTC

fuses.description: Burned NameWrapper fuses; null when the name is not wrapped

gracePeriodEnd.description: ISO 8601 date and time in UTC

name.description: ENS name as the user wrote it, e.g. nick.eth; normalised by the server (ENSIP-15)

reachable.description: Whether ENS resolution still reaches the name's records

inherited.description: Served from a parent (wildcard or off-chain resolver) rather than set on the name

title: Get ENS name details
